_template_notes.about: Template for op25-docker. EASIEST ROUTE: use the web UI (Config tab -> 'Set up my scanner' wizard) instead of editing this file by hand. If editing by hand, replace the example values below with YOUR P25 system's details, then restart op25. Full walkthrough: docs/SETUP.md.
_template_notes.devices: args 'rtl=<index>' selects the RTL-SDR dongle; run SDR -> Scan for devices in the web UI to find the index. 'frequency' is the receive center frequency in Hz (set it to your control channel). 'ppm' corrects crystal drift (0 to start).
_template_notes.channels: 'frequency' in Hz; 'trunking_sysname' MUST equal the 'sysname' of the trunked system below (this links the channel to your trunking system; without it op25 treats the channel as a conventional receiver and never hunts the control channel). 'destination' must match a stream 'udp_port' in stream.json, e.g. udp://127.0.0.1:23456 <-> udp_port 23456. demod/filter/symbol-rate values are P25 defaults; leave them unless you know otherwise. Encrypted traffic is IGNORED by default; to decrypt, put an op25 keys file (keyid -> {algid, key[]}) in conf/ and set 'crypt_keys' to its path, e.g. '/opt/op25/conf/keys.json'. 'crypt_behavior' is auto-managed (2=skip when no keys, 0=allow when keys present).
_template_notes.trunking.chans: 'sysname': any label. 'control_channel_list': control channel in MHz (comma-separate alternates for CC hunting). 'nac': system Network Access Code in hex (0x...). 'sysid'/'wacn': optional, learned from the control channel if left empty. 'phase2_tdma': 1 if the system uses Phase 2 TDMA. 'modulation': 'cqpsk' for 700/800 MHz, 'fm' for VHF/UHF. 'whitelist'/'blacklist': comma-separated talkgroup IDs to restrict or block decoding. 'crypt_behavior' is auto-managed from the matching channel's 'crypt_keys'.
_template_notes.verbosity: op25 log verbosity: 0=quiet, 1=normal, 2=verbose (tag loading), 5=debug (call/CC activity), 9=tuning details, 10=full channel-control trace (very spammy), 11=TSBK detail (all non-voice signaling: grants, patches, affiliations, registrations, band plans). Can be changed live from the web UI (Status tab).
